title: review: fix goal/T-1667 red spawn tests: fake claude CLI vs the new resolver (test_spawn ~15, env_policy, worker_control)
spec:
Goal branch goal/T-1667 is red in spawn-related tests; fix it on top of the rebased auto-merge branch.

Worktree /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/wt/T-1688, branch task/T-1688, head 33a84e2 (= goal/T-1667 + auto-merge commits).
Gate log: wt/T-1688/.orchestrator/runs/tests/T-1688-20261007-003959.log (Planner ran .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh,
exit 2). The T-1695 builder reports goal/T-1667 alone fails the same tests, so the cause is on the goal branch, most likely
the watchdog's claude CLI resolver (orchestrator/claude_cli.py, T-1679/T-1687, including L7 "discard non-absolute
shutil.which results") interacting with how these tests fake the claude CLI (patched shutil.which returning "claude",
a relative fake binary, or a patched Popen that expects the bare name).

Failing (from the log):
- tests/test_spawn.py: OauthTokenInjection (3), ReviewVerdict.test_spawn_records_worker_registry_entry,
  ReviewVerdict.test_spawn_uses_env_policy, RunClaudeBudgetExitReason.test_non_zero_exit_with_json_returns_reason,
  RunClaudeNormalisedUsage.test_run_row_has_normalised_tokens, RunClaudeToolsAndMcpConfig (2+),
  OutputContracts.test_output_contract_active_repair_resume_once_within_budget, and the rest of the ~15 in the log
  (most assert 'held' != 'done': spawn now holds as "claude CLI not found").
- tests/test_env_policy.py test_all_spawn_paths_use_worker_env ("RuntimeError not raised").
- tests/test_worker_control.py Steering.test_steer_claude_resumes_session.

Steps: read the log; reproduce with PYTHONPATH=tests uv run python -m unittest tests.test_spawn tests.test_env_policy
tests.test_worker_control; find the root cause and fix it in the right place. Preferred: a shared test helper (in
tests/_harness.py or a small tests/_fake_claude.py) that patches orchestrator.claude_cli.resolve to return an absolute
fake path, used by every test that fakes the claude CLI. Keep the resolver's hardening (absolute paths only); change
production code only if it is actually wrong (e.g. a spawn path that bypasses the env policy). Do not skip or delete
tests. Then run the FULL gate yourself: `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/wt/T-1688`
(about 7 minutes, foreground) and report its last line. Commit on task/T-1688.
acceptance: no test is skipped or deleted; the resolver still returns absolute paths only

result.summary: Test-only change. The new tests/_fake_claude.py patches claude_cli.resolve to an absolute fake path, and the four affected test files use it in place of patching shutil.which to 'claude'. Production code and the resolver's absolute-path hardening are untouched. No test is skipped or deleted. The recorded gate shows 1 attempt and 0 reds. I did not run the gate or the tests myself, and I did not check that spawn calls claude_cli.resolve as a module attribute (which the patch depends on). One low-severity risk: the module-wide setUpModule fake could mask a missing-CLI regression in the other tests in those files.

comments.issue: The module-wide setUpModule patch applies to every test in test_spawn, test_env_policy and test_worker_control. A future test that should hit the 'claude CLI not found' hold must remember to patch resolve to None. The module-level patch also overrides any setUpModule/tearDownModule those files already define, if they ever add one.

The module-wide fake in test_spawn means the existing missing-CLI hold test (the one that patches orchestrator.claude_cli) must patch resolve itself. I did not confirm it still does, so confirm it does not pass vacuously.
